guard/32174.htm.text: Marksman Maddy: Do you have some business with me? I am Maddy, the Marksman who protects this place. Past here, all the way to the outskirts of the village, you'll find the area swarming with monsters. Unless you're prepared to protect yourself, I wouldn't advise venturing out there recklessly.

links.text: View the information about the lord and manor tax rate.

guard/32174-1.htm.text: Marksman Maddy: Once you leave the village, the only person who can guarantee your safety is you. The main threat is monsters, but there are also some adventurers out there that may attack you. If you choose to fight a monster, well, that's your choice and I wish you well.
